$comment: Sample users for the local dev mock /api (scripts/mock-api.mjs). The mock signs everyone in as users[0] — sign-in 'just works' locally as one fixture identity. admin:true so the movement editor (M5) is exercisable without a real PocketBase. users[0] is committed with NO `handle` on purpose (task L1, DEC-021) so the first sign-in exercises the random adjective-noun assignment path; the assigned handle persists to git-ignored fixtures/users.local.json — delete that file to see the assignment run again. The three org rows (org:true, no password/OAuth) mirror deploy/pocketbase/pb_migrations/1756900000_add_users_handle_and_orgs.js — same fixed ids, same handles — so a duplicate-handle rejection (e.g. editing your handle to 'crossfit') is exercisable locally. Not used in production: PocketBase serves real Google auth and the real migration there.
